items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 28:1
items.html: (To the question) The Mochin that the lower one receives from the upper one are clothed in the NHY of the upper one, as said in the previous parts. Therefore, in the Mochin of face to face, which the Nukva receives from the coupling made in the head of ZA, her Mochin come there clothed in the NHY of ZA. And in the Mochin of the posterior, which come at the time of the separation, which the Nukva receives from the coupling made in Aba and Ima, she therefore receives them in the NHY of Ima.
